primary_objective: Land the lander on the landing pad at (0,0) as fast as possible with minimal fuel consumption.
objective_decomposition: Phase 1: Stabilize and approach the pad from above (control angle and lateral drift).
Phase 2: Descend toward pad with controlled vertical speed, maintaining upright orientation.
Phase 3: Soft touchdown with both legs contacting the pad, minimal residual velocity.
behavior_trajectory_alignment: Phase 1: Stabilize and approach the pad from above (control angle and lateral drift).
Phase 2: Descend toward pad with controlled vertical speed, maintaining upright orientation.
Phase 3: Soft touchdown with both legs contacting the pad, minimal residual velocity.
metric_priority: Episodic return (total reward) averaged over many episodes.
primary_selection_metric: Episodic return (total reward) averaged over many episodes.
proxy_metrics: Cumulative main engine fuel (sum of m_power).
diagnostic_metrics: Success rate (landing on pad with legs contact).
Average fuel consumption per successful landing.
success_criteria: Both legs ground contact (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Lander position near (0,0) with low velocities.
Episode termination without crash or out-of-bounds.
failure_modes: Hovering indefinitely at high altitude (avoids crash but never lands).
Landing outside pad but with legs down (no crash but not on pad).
Excessive use of orientation engines causing fuel waste without progress.
Landing with high vertical velocity but legs contact (crash-like but not detected as crash).
bad_local_optima: Hovering indefinitely at high altitude (avoids crash but never lands).
Landing outside pad but with legs down (no crash but not on pad).
Excessive use of orientation engines causing fuel waste without progress.
Landing with high vertical velocity but legs contact (crash-like but not detected as crash).
reward_generator_constraints: Reward must be a scalar float returned by compute_reward.
Must encourage landing on pad, not just ground contact anywhere.
Must penalize crashes and out-of-bounds strongly.
Fuel efficiency should be encouraged but not dominate safety.
Sparse success signal (landing) may require shaping for learnability.
Avoid positive reward for hovering indefinitely.
